scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof includes exact integral kernel and generating argument. Finite tests are corroborative rather than universal proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The support statement is for the canonical unordered deleted-product cubical chains, not arbitrary singular chain norms; rank-only information was previously available through ordered Betti calculations. A relevant Durham dissertation was not accessible in full; equivalent unindexed results remain a risk. No homotopy-group classification is asserted.
title: Integral symmetry and sharp twenty-four-square homology generators for two particles on complete bipartite graphs
